selection.rule: Retain checked Pareto and all start status, complete vectors, recovery, costs, and exclusion/failure diagnostics. Validate all four final vectors at 17 points; only strict30 and physical PASS go to dense1001, then dense PASS to independent MNA84/power/passivity/SPD. Preserve raw until Git readback and audit.

limitations: Planned only; optimization and post-optimization validation not_run.
Finite-grid diagnostics are not continuous-frequency or implementation guarantees.
